items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-30
items.q: The interviewee (Jack Teagarden) does not mention Rod Alexander; the interviewer mentions Rod Alexander in the context of a tour in Afghanistan, which is unrelated to Jack Teagarden's life or career.

ctx.x: That's nice you wouldn't have food with your head

but but ANTA just sent Rod Alexander over with the dance troupe and they were going to play Kabul and I had been trying to figure out how to send some stuff to the school over there because the packages I wanted to send were too big for the diplomatic pouch you know and and it's pretty hard to get things through the border actually there through Pakistan and Afghanistan so we promoted a set of world books from the Growlier Society and then we bought a bunch of stuff and I bought patterns and slates and chalk and…
I know we didn't get this straight the State Department contacts ANTA
